objective: Determine whether exact historical Level-1 message/snapshot versions can be audibly bound to contemporaneous official dissemination at or before T=15:30 for the frozen Stage10/11 daily dependency need. This is source-evidence feasibility only.

products.scope: official Level-1 intraday snapshot historical product plus contemporaneous Level-1 dissemination semantics
official Level-1 real-time dissemination plus corresponding official historical-retention evidence

requires: official product and historically applicable schema identity
exact original message/snapshot or immutable batch identity
sequence/version identity sufficient to distinguish retransmission/replacement/correction
official dissemination/publication evidence with time semantics precise enough to decide T=15:30
complete correction/replacement lineage or independently justified original-message immutability
retainable raw/audit provenance and deterministic field interpretation

stop_conditions: official evidence cannot link retained historical record to exact originally disseminated version
only event/generation timestamps exist and official dissemination time cannot be proven
correction/replacement completeness or equivalent original-message immutability is unproven
historical product/schema cannot be proven applicable to the frozen window
closing the evidence gap would require Level-2/tick, commercial source, purchase/contact, bulk data or source integration
either venue remains unproven after the one primary pass plus at most one targeted gap pass

four_party_review_required_if: add Level-2, tick or a commercial source
replace a probe date or security
aggregate intraday data into a new daily bar as part of feasibility
purchase, subscribe, contact provider, integrate source or run Stage/PIT predicates

claim_ceiling: A PASS would establish only a candidate evidence mechanism for a future source-integration review. It would not establish P030 strict PIT, daily-bar equivalence, Stage validity, prediction, economics, source admission, production authority or trading authority.
